name: csswitch-operator
description: Operate CSSwitch through an authenticated external control bridge, with native-bridge compatibility.

interface.shortDescription: Control CSSwitch profiles, models, settings, and runtime.
interface.longDescription: CSSwitch Operator gives Codex a guarded path to inspect and manage CSSwitch. It prefers the standalone authenticated loopback bridge, so CSSwitch app updates do not overwrite the control layer; native bridge support remains a compatibility fallback.
defaultPrompt: Check CSSwitch and show the active profile.
List CSSwitch profiles and model settings.
Open the CSSwitch settings I need to change.
